lead.title: OpenAI Discusses $30B Fundraising Round at $1.4T Valuation
lead.summary: OpenAI is in talks to raise $30 billion in what would be the largest private AI fundraising round ever, with UAE funds including MGX anchoring up to $10 billion and BlackRock also participating. The pre-money valuation is pegged at $1.4 trillion and the company's IPO plans have been postponed.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek to Raise Over $12B in Tencent-Backed Funding Round
top_stories.summary: Chinese frontier AI lab DeepSeek is raising at least $12 billion (80B yuan) led by Tencent and CATL, with a pre-IPO planned for early 2027.

top_stories.title: OpenAI Releases Frontier Model Mathematical Results
top_stories.summary: OpenAI published new mathematical results from an internal frontier model, developed with guidance from the Institute for Advanced Study's Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI for responsible disclosure practices.

top_stories.title: OpenAI Launches Decisions API in Public Beta
top_stories.summary: The Decisions API lets applications choose models, tools, or actions in near real-time, claiming up to 10x speed over GPT-6 Luna via the Responses API, competing with Perplexity and TypeSafe AI's Jev.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2
top_stories.summary: A 740M-parameter natively multimodal open embedding model under Apache 2.0, unifying text, code, images, audio, and video into one shared embedding space for on-device multimodal search and private RAG.

items.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents Through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
items.summary: An automatic harness optimizer enabling self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbones, gaining 12.33 points on OSWorld-Verified with Qwen3-VL-32B.

items.title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
items.summary: OnePO one-stage policy optimization for RL-only medical domain adaptation, achieving 67.2 on HealthBench with 20K samples, surpassing SFT+RL baselines.

items.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain Multi-Turn Generalization of Underspecification Signals
items.summary: LLMs routinely answer unanswerable questions; this work shows unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states and generalizes across domains and multi-turn dialogue.

items.title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs
items.summary: Reveals that orthogonal projection methods like O-LoRA create conflicting parameter updates in continual learning; proposes knowledge consolidation and decoupling to resolve catastrophic forgetting.

items.title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
items.summary: Treats alignment as a family of measurable scaling relations across risk categories, modeling the burden needed to hold a fixed safety target as models grow.

items.title: AMD Ryzen AI Max Pro 495 Powers Dozens of AI Mini PCs and Workstations
items.summary: AMD's flagship Gorgon Halo APU with 16 Zen 5 cores, Radeon 8065S graphics, up to 192GB unified LPDDR5X-8533 memory, and 131 TOPS ships in mini workstations from ACEMAGIC, Minisforum, and Framework. Up to 160GB allocatable as VRAM for local 100B+ parameter LLMs.

items.title: TwelveLabs Releases Pegasus 1.6 for First-Person Video Understanding
items.summary: A model that natively understands egocentric (first-person) video, accelerating data labeling for robotics and physical AI training with video tagging, temporal segmentation, and activity recognition.

items.title: FireDome Builds Autonomous 'Artillery' for Wildfire Defense
items.summary: An autonomous ground-based launcher system that fires smart capsules with water or fire retardant up to 1,000 ft, covering 70 acres per unit. Offered as protection-as-a-service at $10K-15K/month.

items.title: Underdog: Fully On-Device Private AI Assistant from Conway Research
items.summary: Sigil Wen launched the most private AI assistant yet — runs entirely on-device via custom inference engine (Husky) using a fine-tuned Qwen3.8 27B model. Backed by a16z and Khosla Ventures.

items.title: FastRouter.ai: Intelligent LLM Routing for Cost, Latency, and Quality
items.summary: An LLM routing layer that intelligently dispatches API requests to the optimal model based on cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs. Topped Product Hunt on October 6.

items.title: Cloudflare Web Search API Gives AI Agents Access to Live Internet Data
items.summary: Cloudflare launched a Web Search API allowing AI agents to query live internet data through a simple API interface, bridging the gap between LLMs and current information.

items.title: devpit: A Native Control Room for Your Claude Code Agents
items.summary: Desktop app providing a control room UI for managing, monitoring, and debugging Claude Code agent sessions with live cost tracking and session controls.

items.title: OpenBot: Tag Specialized Agents Like Friends or Employees
items.summary: Open-source, local-first multi-agent runtime that lets you tag agents by capability and orchestrate them via a tag-and-channel system in your local filesystem.
